CommentRecord.description: One of an item's comments, as its provider records it.

created_at.description: RFC 3339; absent, when the host recorded it.

id.description: The provider's own id for it, unique on the item.

LinkRecord.description: One of an item's links, as its provider records it.

target.description:
What it points at: another item (`oxplow:oxplow/work_item?id=<id>&provider=<provider>`), or
any ref the item is about (`oxplow:oxplow/collector?collector=triage/hot`, `oxplow:oxplow/effort?id=eff12`).

WorkItemRecord.description:
An item as its provider now has it — what `v_work_item` holds, and
what a provider's `work_item.recorded` event carries. Who it's
assigned to and its place in that queue are core's, never a
provider's. `links` and `comments` are stated when the provider keeps them: absent, the
host keeps what it has; present, it's the whole set.

links.description: Its links (from it to others), the whole set.

stage.description:
Which of the list's declared stages it's in (its bucket is core's
lookup).

description:
`work_item.recorded@3`: a list's item as it now stands — how every
list's items reach the work-item interface (the `work_items.project`
consumer upserts it by ref), with its links and comments when it
states them. A list's verbs answer with it. Who it's assigned to and
its place in their queue aren't a list's: core records them
(`work_item.assigned`).
title: WorkItemRecordedV3
